Compile and configure subsampling custom-Stan models

Source: R/stan_subsampling.R
stan_subsampling.Rd

`pdmp_subsample_hpp_path()` returns the installed thread-local subset-hook header. `compile_pdmp_stan_model()` compiles a Stan source with the required `–allow-undefined` and `USER_HEADER` settings.

Specifies exact subsampling for an ordinal Markov random field (OMRF) likelihood with one likelihood contribution per person. The residual of a person's gradient is taken relative to an analytic, undamped Hessian control variate at the anchor, and every grid cell gets a certified roof on the summed residual rates. Threshold and interaction arguments are Stan unconstrained block names and are resolved at sampler initialization. The prior gradient is analytic, so `prior_standata` passed to [stan_subsampling()] must follow one of the package's OMRF prior contracts.

Usage

pdmp_subsample_hpp_path()

compile_pdmp_stan_model(path, compile_options = stan_compile_options())

stan_residual_envelope(weights, growth_rates = NULL)

stan_subsampling(
  n_observations,
  subsample_size,
  prior_standata,
  residual_envelope,
  anchor = NULL
)

omrf_residual_envelope(
  X,
  seen,
  thresholds,
  interactions,
  exact_selected_refinement = TRUE,
  person_signed_roof = FALSE,
  signed_only_person_roof = FALSE,
  joint_signed_group_size = 0L,
  shared_current_categorical = FALSE
)

stan_parameter_mapping(path_to_stanmodel, standata, parameters = NULL)

Arguments

path

Path to a Stan source file.

compile_options

Settings from stan_compile_options.

weights

Nonnegative component-by-observation curvature weights.

growth_rates

Optional nonnegative growth coefficient per component.

n_observations

Total number of subsampling likelihood contributions.

subsample_size

Number drawn without replacement at each proposal.

prior_standata

Prior-only data list or JSON path for the same model.

residual_envelope

A certified object from [stan_residual_envelope()] or a recognized package provider such as [omrf_residual_envelope()].

anchor

Optional unconstrained anchor.

X

Integer person-by-node matrix encoded from zero.

seen

Number of observed categories per node.

thresholds

Threshold parameter block name.

interactions

Interaction parameter block name; edge order is the upper triangle `(1,2), (1,3), ..., (P-1,P)`.

exact_selected_refinement

If `TRUE` (default), the selected person's residual is evaluated once while thinning against the subset bound and reused for the candidate rate. `FALSE` thins against the drawn roof only.

person_signed_roof

Linear BPS certificate policy. Signed node residual endpoints are summed within each person before taking an absolute bound; the factor-summed certificate remains a valid fallback. The estimator and retained target are unchanged. Other flows keep the ordinary roof.

signed_only_person_roof

Linear BPS policy which builds the certified signed whole-person endpoint roof without also building the factor-summed fallback table. It preserves the estimator and uses pointwise factor refinement for the selected person. Requires `person_signed_roof = TRUE`.

joint_signed_group_size

Linear BPS joint signed marked roof. Use `4` for fixed seeded groups of four, `16`, `32` or `64` for weighted ragged groups, or `0` to keep the ordinary scheduler. Requires `signed_only_person_roof = TRUE`.

shared_current_categorical

Evaluator that reuses current categorical moments for exact active-neighbour patterns. Requires joint groups.

path_to_stanmodel

Stan source or compiled-library path.

standata

Named data list or JSON path.

parameters

Optional unconstrained names, block prefixes, or indices.

Value

The header path, or the compiled shared-library path.

A declarative residual-envelope specification.

A validated observation-subsampling specification.

A certified Stan residual-envelope specification.

A data frame with resolved 1-based indices and names.
